newsitem.title: UK: Reuters takes stake in Thailand's Bisnews.
newsitem.headline: Reuters takes stake in Thailand's Bisnews.

text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it had bought a 49 percent stake in Thailand's Bisnews Information Services Ltd, a supplier of domestic real-time data and news to over 7,600 financial market participants, for a price of 10.6 million stg cash.
Bisnews, based in Bangkok, provides market information services to meet the needs of domestic equity, fixed income and corporate market participants.
Reuters, the international news and information group, said in a statement it would assume responsibility for the management of Bisnews and for setting its future corporate direction.

"Through its investment in Bisnews, Reuters will substantially increase its share of Thailand's real-time information market," the statement quoted Mark Robson, Reuters manager for Thailand, as saying.
It did not specify the company's existing or likely future market share, however.
